purpose: Bind an explicit runtime, browser, visual, gameplay, accessibility, or host-specific observation to the exact current project-file digests, preserve freshness and claim-level PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED evidence, and avoid relabeling an external observation as deterministic core proof.

properties.path: bind only; exact created project directory
properties.expected_file_digests: bind only; complete exact digest map from the observed project body
properties.evidence: bind only; typed external observation with observer, time, freshness lifetime, claims, evidence references, limitations, and optional attachment digests

contains: exact project file manifest and digest

anatomy_refs.basis: The capability normalizes a bounded observer-supplied claim set, preserves evidence references and limitations, checks freshness, and digest-binds the observation to one exact project body.
Host observations extend rather than replace the deterministic structural validation boundary.

relationships: allows browser, visual, gameplay, runtime, and accessibility verifiers to return exact bounded evidence
refuses evidence for a changed or incomplete project digest map
turns stale external PASS/FAIL into effective UNKNOWN without deleting the original observation
does not write an automatic activity log or grant execution authority
limitations: the core validates the evidence envelope, project binding, internal status consistency, and freshness but does not independently repeat the external observation
an image or browser receipt proves only its named bounded claims
host evidence does not install, adopt, merge, grant authority, or establish general semantic correctness

truth.basis: External observations stay attributed, claim-bounded, freshness-aware, digest-bound, and explicitly not independently re-performed by the core.

agency.basis: The caller chooses whether to request and preserve host evidence; the capability does not monitor or log activity automatically.

continuity.basis: Evidence is accepted only for the exact unchanged project-file body identified by the supplied complete digest map.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Missing, contradictory, stale, malformed, or body-drifted evidence stops or becomes UNKNOWN instead of being promoted to a pass.
